_note: WHEN each post went live. Data, not code, because a tool edits it every publishing day and a tool must never rewrite a source file. A post with no entry here is a DRAFT: written, in the repository, excluded from the index, the sitemap, the feed, llms.txt and every related-post block. Nothing here is a promise about a future date — an entry appears on the day the post is published, added by backend/tools/blog-publish.mjs. A post with a "retired" date was published or written and has been DELIBERATELY WITHDRAWN: it is excluded from the index, the sitemap, the feed and every related-post block exactly like a draft, but it is also excluded from the publishing queue, so nothing offers to publish it and no command publishes it by accident. Removing the retired entry is the only way to bring it back, which is a decision somebody has to make on purpose.
